description: Candidate content sources for Noor (Phase 0). Read by scripts/sources/fetch-sources.mjs, which downloads every file, records SHA-256 and writes SOURCES.lock.json. Paths are relative to data/sources/. Nothing here is approved yet: status stays 'candidate' until the owner approves an item.
userAgent: NoorSourcesFetch/0.1 (Phase 0 source evaluation; contact: project owner)

sources.name: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani + Simple Clean)

license.name: Tanzil Terms of Use; file header also states Creative Commons Attribution 3.0
license.quote: Permission is granted to copy and distribute verbatim copies of this text, but CHANGING IT IS NOT ALLOWED. This Quran text can be used in any website or application, provided that its source (Tanzil Project) is clearly indicated, and a link is made to tanzil.net to enable users to keep track of changes. This copyright notice shall be included in all verbatim copies of the text, and shall be reproduced appropriately in all files derived from or containing substantial portion of this text.

sources.attribution: Quran text: Tanzil Project (https://tanzil.net)
sources.notes: Downloading requires agree=true (acceptance of the Terms of Use), approved by the owner with the Phase 0 plan. XML output keeps the Basmala of surahs 2-114 in a separate 'bismillah' attribute. Rub-el-hizb signs are excluded (quarters come from metadata); sequential tanween (me_quran-only) is off. The file header says Copyright (C) 2007-2026, i.e. the year changes, so a re-download next year will change the SHA-256 even if the text does not.

approval.note: Tanzil default variant (tatweel=true). Surah-header Basmala taken verbatim from each surah's bismillah attribute (incl. the 95/97 shadda variant).

files.notes: Downloaded only to document how the text format treats the Basmala; not an import candidate.
Search-index input only (SPEC 2.4); never displayed as Quran. Downloaded without pause marks and sajdah signs (with marks=true Tanzil inserts U+06D6..U+06DC and U+06E9 into the clean text).

approval.note: Input of the normalized search index only; never displayed as Quran.
